prompt: Under the Texas Zero Tolerance law, what alcohol concentration triggers a DUI charge for a minor under 21?

options.text: Only when the minor's blood alcohol concentration exceeds the 0.08 adult limit
A BAC exceeding 0.05 measured during certified forensic laboratory blood tests
Zero Tolerance applies exclusively to minors operating commercial school buses
Any detectable amount of alcohol in the minor's system while driving a vehicle
